entities.name: Magfire
entities.description: Leader of the Folk of the Pines in Arboria on Jamuraa around 3334 AR.

entities.name: Arboria
entities.description: Home of the Folk of the Pines.

entities.name: Adira Strongheart
entities.description: Leader of the Circle of Seven, wrecked in Buzzard's Bay.

entities.name: Shauku
entities.description: Ancient vampire who trapped Johan in an Amber Prison.

entities.name: Johan
entities.description: Trapped in an Amber Prison, later released; killed Taurion at Palmyra.

entities.name: Taurion
entities.description: Magfire's brother who joined Adira's Circle of Seven and was killed by Johan.

entities.name: Caverns of Despair
entities.description: Caverns containing Ghosts of the Damned and Crimson Kobolds.

entities.name: Cosmic Horror
entities.description: Horror trapped in the tunnels, released to defeat Shauku; it summoned a Falling Star.

entities.name: Battle of Palmyra
entities.description: Battle in which Taurion was killed by Johan.

events.summary: Magfire and her people meet Adira and her Circle of Seven after their wreck in Buzzard's Bay and warn them of Shauku and the trapped horror.
events.quote: Magfire warned the pirates of Shauku and the trapped Cosmic Horror in the tunnels below

events.summary: They enter the Caverns of Despair and learn the ancient vampire trapped Johan in an Amber Prison.
events.quote: the ancient vampire had trapped Johan in an Amber Prison

events.summary: To defeat Shauku they release the horror, which summons a Falling Star; Johan is freed and runs away.
events.quote: To defeat Shauku, they released the horror from its prison, and it summoned a Falling Star

events.summary: After they flee into Arboria, the meteorite obliterates the ruined castle.
events.quote: the meteorite struck the ruined castle, obliterating it

events.summary: Taurion volunteers to join Adira's Circle of Seven while Magfire stays behind.
events.quote: Magfire's brother Taurion volunteered to become part of Adira's Circle of Seven, while Magfire stayed behind

events.summary: Magfire assists at the Battle of Palmyra, where Johan kills Taurion.
events.quote: where her brother Taurion was killed by Johan

relations.quote: Magfire was the leader of the Folk of the Pines
where her brother Taurion was killed by Johan
